about_short_description.short_description: RSA Global provides logistics management, freight forwarding, and supply chain solutions to consumers.

product.name: E-commerce Fulfillment
product.description: Service managing the storage, packing, and shipping of online orders to end consumers, supporting multi-channel sales and real-time inventory tracking.

product.name: Importer of Record (IOR)
product.description: A service managing customs clearance, compliance, and import documentation for goods entering the UAE and MENA region.

product.name: International Freight Forwarding
product.description: Coordinated air, sea, and land freight services to transport goods globally, leveraging a wide network of carriers and strategic locations.

product.name: Warehouse Solutions
product.description: Storage and inventory management services with real-time stock visibility and qualified personnel handling goods for various industries.

product.name: Transport & Distribution
product.description: Planning and execution of product transportation and distribution to ensure timely and accurate delivery within supply chains.

product.name: On-Site Logistics
product.description: Logistics management services conducted directly at customer sites to improve inventory accuracy and supply chain safety.
